## Governance metadata

- **PR class**: feature
- **Task ID(s)**: M14-004
- **Risk tier**: R2
- **Accountable owner**: @Chengyue-Lu
- **Workstream**: docs/workstreams/chengyue-lu/M14-CURATED-RELEASE

## Scope and non-goals

Getting Started now completes the accepted M1-009 user path: install outside the checkout, initialize and validate a no-Skill project, create the offline example, locate its pinned evidence, check the Run, explicitly reconstruct it and validate the actual report. README and the support matrix link to these canonical steps; Changelog reflects the available flow.

The public-doc checker inspects rendered Markdown href/src values, including entity-encoded destinations, references and URI/bare autolinks; code spans and blocks remain literal. markdown-it-py and linkify-it-py are development/test dependencies only. The support matrix describes Research State and bounded continuity candidate behavior. Product code, Runtime resources, release policy and authority semantics are unchanged.

M14-005 remains BLOCKED. No release branch, tag, protection configuration, topology activation or release is part of this PR.

## Contract and authority impact

- **Shared contract**: yes
- **Authority impact**: no

This completes the public documentation contract and its development-side closure check under the accepted R2 Task. Structural validation, bounded reconstruction, live conformance and evaluated scientific benefit retain separate meanings.

## TASKS transition

M14-004: READY -> DONE. The original Task identity, dependencies, owner and acceptance are unchanged. This is the completion proposal for cross-owner R2 acceptance. M1-009 was accepted and merged in PR #74; public-surface preparation was accepted in PR #69.

## Verification evidence

- Current candidate: `cbf646d1d4139da249277615a88f54d9cdf5586d`, on `develop@451644064f558601d5778b9b115390f882f4d260`. Review correction implementation: `992db5b53463b7b0c55851ff842485fb8f50615e`.
- The new parser regressions failed before the fix (9 failures). After the fix, public-surface/documentation/governance focused checks pass 106/106. These include the two reported bypasses and positive code/prose controls. Repository validation is 186/0/0; Trace has no BLOCK, with native capture gaps explicitly retained; whitespace checks pass.
- Two corrected-source exports under policy `1.1.0`: 257 files, byte-identical, with closed public links/build inputs and product source/Schema bytes equal to their Git source. Fixture source-CI expectations are synthetic and confer no release authority. Evidence: `work/M14-004/A-20260914-001`.
- Historical Quickstart walkthrough: implementation `3591043fb870582ae674e1ac9ce994a0bc9675b3` passed 8/8 projected-source installations (Python 3.11.16/3.13.15 × direct/sdist-wheel × isolated/poisoned), each executing all 12 guide commands and producing a validated, executed `matched` report with the zero-net-change result preserved. No manual Registry/Profile/Skill copies, Provider credentials, generated-file edits or command corrections were needed in that automated walkthrough. This is not a human usability study.
- The guide, Runtime and template bytes remain unchanged. The review fix changes public support wording and test-extra package metadata, so the historical walkthrough in `work/M14-004/A-20260912-001` is not presented as a current artifact identity. Current-candidate standard package smoke verifies the corrected metadata independently.
- [Current-candidate CI run 34768338266](https://github.com/Chengyue-Lu/research-agent-workbench/actions/runs/34768338266): SUCCESS. Full Python 3.11/3.13 each 1229/1229 PASS; repository coverage, documentation, repository smoke, both package-smoke jobs and both final test gates pass. Current-head governance also passes.
- Plan `f395ac1113eda45fce19450d9627c3925776da1e713df444ff781e070eb8444f` binds base `451644064f558601d5778b9b115390f882f4d260`, head `cbf646d1d4139da249277615a88f54d9cdf5586d` and merge target `9f58a3e6511f023057cee1448c5850d76b2b2c88`. Full and coverage result artifacts were checked against this identity. The accepted planner requires full + repository coverage because pyproject/test-extra metadata changed. Previous focused run `34696336139` is retained only as historical evidence.

## Residual risk and follow-up

The example is a synthetic bounded file reconstruction; initialization does not run it, and explicit reproduction executes trusted code without an OS sandbox. Scientific Claim acceptance, live Provider conformance and system net benefit are not established by this walkthrough. After M14-004 acceptance, M14-005 still requires licensing, actual remote protection, a named Human release decision and its readiness/cutover checks.

## Authority basis

Chengyue-Lu owns M14-004 public/release semantics. The user authorized advancing after M1-009 review; PR #74 was merged at its approved exact head with all checks passing. This PR requests cross-owner R2 review from let778750-cpu. Named Human Claim and release decisions remain with their existing authorities; the primary local develop checkout is unchanged.

## Adversarial evidence

Regression cases block decimal/hex HTML entity destinations, relative and external links, reference/collapsed/shortcut links, URI and bare autolinks, images, percent-encoded internal paths, excluded targets/anchors and missing build inputs. Code spans, fenced/indented code and ordinary generated Attempt paths remain valid; a double-encoded literal entity is not recursively decoded into a different destination. Existing isolated/poisoned package and resource-corruption checks remain active. Reconstruction authority flags and release topology retain their fail-closed boundaries.
